definitions.D0: count of crops grown in a year, averaged over years
definitions.D1: effective number of crops, exp(Shannon), per year then averaged
definitions.D2: number of main crops, inverse Simpson, per year then averaged
definitions.tsh: average over years of the largest crop's share of gross cropped area; the largest crop is the one with the most land on average
definitions.t2sh: the same for the two largest crops together

cls.mono: largest crop holds at least two thirds of the land
cls.pair: two largest crops hold at least 80 percent, neither alone two thirds
cls.few: fewer than 10 crops a year and neither of the above

systems.rice-wheat: rice leads the monsoon, wheat leads rabi, each at least 20 percent of the year's land
systems.rice-rice: rice leads the monsoon and leads rabi or summer as well, with that second rice crop at least 10 percent of the year's land
systems.pairs: monsoon leader then the leader of rabi plus summer, when that crop is at least 10 percent of the year's land; otherwise 'little second season'
systems.whole: 'Whole Year' rows are at least half the land
systems.district: each district-year is classified; the district takes its most frequent class

definitions.keys: districts keyed like the 'k' property of districts.geojson; dk is the analysis key used by site_indices.json
definitions.sample: 'sample' is the 606-district analysis set; 'all' is the 725 crop-record districts; 'all_10y' is the 725 restricted to districts observed for at least 10 years
